name: netmedex-controlled-bridge-reviewed-distractors-v1
selection_rule: canonical bridge from preflight plus endpoint-only distractors

mediators.name: DUOX2
mediators.source_query: (CFTR[Title/Abstract] OR cystic fibrosis[Title/Abstract]) AND (DUOX2[Title/Abstract] OR dual oxidase 2[Title/Abstract])
mediators.target_query: (DUOX2[Title/Abstract] OR dual oxidase 2[Title/Abstract]) AND (intestinal inflammation[Title/Abstract] OR gut inflammation[Title/Abstract] OR colitis[Title/Abstract])
mediators.rationale: DUOX2 is a specific, non-hub oxidase.
mediators.why_text_rag_may_miss: DUOX2 is rarely linked to CFTR in general reviews.
mediators.falsifiable_hypothesis: DUOX2 inhibition reduces inflammation in CFTR-deficient intestine.

BW003.target_distractor_query: (intestinal inflammation[Title/Abstract] OR gut inflammation[Title/Abstract] OR colitis[Title/Abstract])

mediators.name: HMGB1
mediators.source_query: (dystrophin[Title/Abstract] OR Duchenne[Title/Abstract] OR mdx[Title/Abstract]) AND (HMGB1[Title/Abstract] OR high mobility group box 1[Title/Abstract])
mediators.target_query: (HMGB1[Title/Abstract] OR high mobility group box 1[Title/Abstract]) AND (chronic inflammation[Title/Abstract] OR inflammatory signaling[Title/Abstract])
mediators.rationale: HMGB1 is a specific DAMP protein.
mediators.why_text_rag_may_miss: HMGB1 is not a standard dystrophin-inflammation link.
mediators.falsifiable_hypothesis: HMGB1 blockade reduces inflammation in dystrophin-deficient muscle.

mediators.name: Galectin-3
mediators.source_query: (dystrophin[Title/Abstract] OR Duchenne[Title/Abstract] OR mdx[Title/Abstract]) AND (Galectin-3[Title/Abstract] OR LGALS3[Title/Abstract])
mediators.target_query: (Galectin-3[Title/Abstract] OR LGALS3[Title/Abstract]) AND (chronic inflammation[Title/Abstract] OR inflammatory signaling[Title/Abstract])
mediators.why_text_rag_may_miss: Galectin-3 is rarely retrieved in top-k muscle inflammation answers.
mediators.falsifiable_hypothesis: Galectin-3 inhibition reduces chronic inflammation in dystrophin-deficient models.

BW006.target_distractor_query: (chronic inflammation[Title/Abstract] OR skeletal muscle inflammation[Title/Abstract] OR muscle inflammatory[Title/Abstract])
